learner_operation: Transform the printed boundaries, find a finite Type I domain, calculate the absolute reciprocal determinant, and integrate the vertical width to select the exact area.

fixed_features.feature: Supplied invertible affine maps and five-choice radio response
fixed_features.justification: Canonical four-step example and all twelve source banks; changing these would change the assessed method or response contract.

fixed_features.feature: Easy uses the simple unit-determinant, unshifted quadratic cap with square heights
fixed_features.justification: Conservative q-38374 family makes intersection coordinates integers while preserving transformation and area integration. Unit shear changes are not claimed to change the area.

fixed_features.feature: Finite source-derived families and constant positive area
fixed_features.justification: Region area must be positive; easy six distinct height-dependent areas form a justified finite beginner family. Larger counts of texts from shear changes do not establish broader skill coverage.

answer_roles.role: Correct area and corresponding answer choice
answer_roles.eligible_variation: All five eligible numerical values in a compatible bank may be correct when the printed region or Jacobian changes. Rank and position are incidental.
answer_roles.observed: Each of eight families supports five different correct ranks and positions with the same ordered bank seed.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Retain observed upward/downward and positive/negative determinant cases across appropriate source families; vary coefficients, cap gaps, shifts and hyperbola bounds without adding methods.
answer_roles.observed: Up, down, vertical, mixed, quartic, hyperbola and simple cases retained. Generated difficulty bands are unchanged by this repair.

stages_examined: Candidate rejection until five distinct areas (code inspection and fresh samples)
Uniform target choice after bank construction
CLI bounded sampling and mathematical-fingerprint deduplication (code inspection and finite-limit test)
Shared publisher normalization, asset localization, inventory and within-batch deduplication
Read-only modeled fresh learner weighted selection
delivery.result: Five of five exact batch records survive; independently sampled easy delivery retains all five rank assignments. Retired historical generated items cannot reintroduce the prior shortcut. Selection preserves availability of the five new easy candidates for a fresh learner.

limitations: No finite audit proves absence of every shortcut.

Five additional source profiles now support exact raw replay only; the repeated-practice sampler still uses eight source-derived families. Raw replay preserves captured mistakes and missing keys and is explicitly evidence-only.
No current publication/preparation.json exists; shared read-only preparation used inventory basis 5602. Live policy, learner history and subsequent inventory changes are unavailable.
